title: Shaping Latent Mixture-of-Experts: From Expert Geometry to Layerwise Capacity Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2610.14644v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fine-grained mixture-of-experts (MoE) models commonly increase expert count by narrowing each expert, treating expert shape as a by-product of routing granularity. LatentMoE moves expert computation into a lower-dimensional space, exposing the input dimension and intermediate width of each expert as explicit design choices. We show that an expert's local Jacobian rank is jointly bounded by these two dimensions, and that balancing them maximizes the rank ceiling at fixed per-expert parameters. Controlled shape sweeps across model scales and routing granularities consistently favor near-square experts. We further use layerwise intrinsic dimension (ID) to guide capacity allocation across depth, co-varying the number and shape of experts while keeping per-layer parameter count, activated FLOPs, and communication volume constant. translated_title: 塑造潜在专家混合模型：从专家几何到逐层容量分配
translated_abstract: 细粒度专家混合模型通常通过收窄每个专家来增加专家数量，将专家形状视为路由粒度的副产品。LatentMoE 将专家计算转移到低维空间中，使每个专家的输入维度和中间宽度成为显式的设计选择。我们证明，专家的局部雅可比秩由这两个维度共同约束，并且在固定每个专家参数量的条件下，平衡这两个维度可以最大化秩的上限。在不同模型规模和路由粒度下进行的受控形状扫描实验一致表明，接近方形的专家表现最优。我们进一步利用逐层内在维度（ID）来指导跨深度的容量分配，在保持每层参数量、激活 FLOPs 和通信量不变的情况下，协同调整专家的数量与形状。与层间同质的基线相比，我们基于 ID 引导的分配方式实现了更低的验证损失和更强的下游性能。
tldr: 该论文提出 LatentMoE，将专家的输入维度与中间宽度作为显式设计选择，证明两者平衡（近方形专家）可在固定参数量下最大化雅可比秩上限，并进一步利用逐层内在维度指导跨层的专家数量与形状分配，在相同计算量下取得更低的验证损失。
en_tdlr: LatentMoE treats expert shape (input dimension vs. intermediate width) as an explicit design choice, showing that near-square experts maximize Jacobian rank under fixed per-expert parameters, and further uses layerwise intrinsic dimension to guide expert count and shape allocation across depth, achieving lower validation loss at matched compute.
